Same crash as 2047150134 (`leaves5.json`); dozens of other corpus scenes with particle systems (presets with or without `instanceoverride`) build fine.
scenes.todo: Phase 6 — docs/TODO.md "LWE: CParticle segfault on embedded leaves presets"

scenes.cause: LWE reads a text object's `padding` as a number; this scene writes it as a "x y" string → an uncaught JSON exception aborts the load
scenes.note: gdb: `nlohmann::json type_error 302 (type must be number, but is string)` thrown in `JsonExtensions::optional<int>` ← `ObjectParser::parseText` ← `WallpaperParser::parseObjects` ← `ProjectParser::parse` ← `wp_project_load_folder`; nothing catches it at the C API, so `terminate` → SIGABRT at every load: 4 crashes → broken (correct crash policy, but a load failure should not be a crash loop). Of the 45 corpus scenes with text objects exactly these two (3233141951, 3326873240) have a string `padding` (`"32.00000 32.00000"`); the 43 with a number get past the text parser. Reproduced with `--lwe-smoke`.
scenes.todo: Phase 6 — docs/TODO.md "LWE: text `padding` as a vec2 string" + "LWE: catch exceptions at the wp_* C API"
